result.Method of Attack: Exploitation of publicly accessible Redis servers via Redis CONFIG and SET commands to inject malicious cron jobs; propagation as a worm; deployment of custom XMRig miner payload; use of obfuscation and anti-forensics techniques
result.Impacted Systems: Linux hosts running publicly accessible Redis servers without proper authentication or protection
result.Attack Vector: Internet-wide scanning for Redis servers on default port 6379; exploitation of Redis configuration commands to write cron jobs
